source_orbit_runtime_assets.active_scope: Fixed-epoch native F880 initialization followed by ordinary F866 orbital updates, source clock and parent translations; retained analytic SI radius/mass/gravity/spin and legacy saved layouts.

native_fixture.scope: Pinned JJFFE F1507/F1508 Q31 position/interpolation, original F1506 radial and F1509/F1510 phase algorithms, the exact F880 rate/init slice, direct F1661 vector addition, and the ordinary pinned F866 orbital update slice. Position variant differs from uploaded DOS and is explicitly identified; no full F866 body policy, F880 allocation, F1677 hierarchy traversal, radius, gravity or SI claim.

dos_f880_rate_and_initialization_slice.phase_call_word_order: source F880 passes day as low and tick as high; source F866 delta uses ordinary tick-low/day-high order

pinned_f866_ordinary_orbital_slice.scope: Ordinary orbital branch including phase add and pinned JJFFE recompute/interpolate dispatch; excludes selection by ship flags, shields and surface rotation
pinned_f866_ordinary_orbital_slice.position_dispatch: Pinned JJFFE jump recomputes F1507 whenever phase high word changes; F1508 interpolation arm remains present but unreachable in this pinned source

source_physics_ports_runtime_assets.active_scope: Native orbital station centres in a non-rotating station-following frame; prepared F880 a4 fields and separately available raw F603/F1511/F1512 primitives.

native_fixture.scope: Complete pinned F603 velocity/fraction update with actual F1532 parent lookup, F880 coefficient slice, complete F1511 and F1512 position integration. No complete world physics/frame selection, surface radius, source timer or SI bridge claim.

F880_coefficient_slice.scope: Exact F880 packed coefficient initialization only; excludes allocation and da frame-selection adjustments

source_full_runtime_assets.raw_source_motion_scope: Optional new-FULL-session Cobra motion around one fixed natural focus; ports, surfaces, vertical assist and other profiles retain the existing path.

navigation_runtime_assets.galactic_search_scope: bounded local window plus original named-system catalogue, not exhaustive global name enumeration
navigation_runtime_assets.raw_source_motion_scope: Optional new FULL sessions; Cobra around a fixed natural focus; ports/surfaces/vertical assist and other profiles use existing fallback.
